faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Simon Fraser Hills?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 11 condos and townhomes listed in Simon Fraser Hills. Those are month-end counts and they move daily, so ask Jared for a current list.

faq.q: Is Simon Fraser Hills a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In September 2026, condos and townhomes had 18% (a balanced market). The sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed; on the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers. One month in one community is a small sample, so look at the monthly table above before you decide.

faq.q: How many homes sold in Simon Fraser Hills from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 0 houses and 8 condos and townhomes sold in Simon Fraser Hills over those 4 months; condos and townhomes peaked in June with 3 sold.

faq.q: How big is Simon Fraser Hills compared with the rest of Burnaby?
faq.a: In September 2026, Simon Fraser Hills held 0.8% of the 1,333 condos and townhomes listed in Burnaby.

faq.q: Are there more or fewer homes for sale in Simon Fraser Hills than in June?
faq.a: Listings of condos and townhomes rose from 10 to 11 (+10.0%) between June 2026 and September 2026.
